questions.question: The sum of Rs. 500 becomes Rs. 600 in 2 years at a certain rate of simple interest. If the rate of interest is halved, then what amount will Rs. 500 give in 2 years?
questions.solution:
Interest in 2 years for Rs. 500 = 600 – 500 = Rs. 100

⇒ If the rate of interest is halved than interest will be half.

⇒ Interest in 2 years for Rs. 500 at half rate of interest = 100/2 = Rs. 50

⇒ Amount = 500 + 50 = Rs. 550

∴ The final amount will be Rs. 550.

questions.question: If x : y : z = 3 : 4 : 5 and x + y + z = 96, then what is the value of z?
questions.solution:
**Short trick****∶**

Value of z = 5/(3 + 4 + 5) × 96 = 40

**Detailed solution****∶**

Let the value of x, y and z be 3a, 4a and 5a

⇒ x + y + z = 96

⇒ 3a + 4a + 5a = 96

⇒ 12a = 96

⇒ a = 8

⇒ The value of z = 5a = 40

∴ The value of z is 40.

questions.question: Pipe A can completely fill an empty tank in 11 hours. Pipe B can empty the same completely filled tank in 15 hours. If they are opened together, in how much time the empty tank will get filled?
questions.solution:
Pipe A (Fill) = 11 hours

Pipe B (Empty) = 15 hours

⇒ L.C.M. of 11 and 15 is 165

⇒ Let the total work be 165 units

⇒ Efficiency of pipe A = 165/11 = 15 units

⇒ Efficiency of pipe B = 165/15 = – 11 units ((Empty))

⇒ Pipe A and B can fill the tank = 165/(15 – 11) = 165/4 = 41.25 hours

⇒ Pipe A and B can fill the tank = 41 hours 15 minutes

∴ The tank will be filled by pipe A and pipe B in 41 hours 15 minutes.

questions.question: A sold an article for Rs. 1495 at a profit of 15%. He purchased another article having cost price equal to the previous article. He sold this new article at a profit of 10%. How much total profit has A earned?
questions.solution:
⇒ Cost price of first article × (100 + profit)% = selling price

⇒ Cost price of first article = 1495/(100 + 15)%

⇒ The cost price of the first article = (1495/115) × 100

⇒ The cost price of first article = Rs. 1300

⇒ Profit
 on the first article = selling price – cost price

⇒ Profit on first article = 1495 – 1300 = Rs. 195

⇒ The cost price of the second article = Rs. 1300

⇒ The selling price of the second article = cost price × (100 + profit)%

⇒ Selling price of second article = 1300 × (100 + 10)%

⇒ The selling price of the second article = 1300 × 110/100

⇒ The selling price of the second article = Rs. 1430

⇒ Profit in second article = 1430 – 1300 = Rs. 130

⇒ Total profit = 195 + 130 = Rs. 325

∴ Total profit in two articles is Rs. 325

questions.question: A is the smallest three-digit number which when divided by 3, 4 and 5 leaves remainders 1, 2 and 3 respectively. What is the sum of the digits of A?
questions.solution:
3 – 1 = 2, 4 – 2 = 2, 5 – 3 = 2

⇒ L.C.M. of 3, 4 and 5 is 60

⇒ Required 3 digit number = 60 × 2 = 120

⇒ 3 digit number when divided by 3, 4 and 5 leaves remainders 1, 2 and 3 respectively

= 120 – 2 = 118

⇒ The sum of the digits of 118 = 1 + 1 + 8 = 10

∴ The sum of the digits is 10.

The average age of a group of 36 students is 23 years. Four students with average age 22 years leave the group. What is the average age in years (correct up to one decimal place) of the new group?
questions.solution:
The sum of age of a group of 36 students = 23 × 36 = 828 years

⇒ The sum of age of 4 students = 22 × 4 = 88

⇒ The sum of age of a group of (36 – 4 = 32) students = 828 – 88 = 740 years

⇒ The average age of a group of 32 students = 740/32 = 23.1 years

∴ The average age of a group of 32 students is 23.1 years.

questions.question: A alone can do a piece of work in 10 days, A and B together can do the same piece of work in 20/3 days. A, B and C together can do the same piece of work in 40/7 days. In how many days can B and C together do the same piece of work?
questions.solution:
A = 10 days

⇒ A + B = 20/3 days

⇒ A + B + C = 40/7 days

L.C.M. of 10, 20/3 and 40/7 is 40 (total work).

⇒ Efficiency of A = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 ---- (1)

⇒ Efficiency of A + B = 40 ÷ 20/3 = 6

⇒ Efficiency of A + B + C = 40 ÷ 40/7 = 7 ---- (2)

From (2) – (1)

⇒ Efficiency of B + C = 7 – 4 = 3

⇒ B and C together do the same piece of work = 40/3 days

∴ B and C together do the same piece of work in 40/3 days.

questions.question: A sum of money is invested at compound interest, which is compounded annually. The sum grows to Rs. 1000 after three years, and Rs. 1100 after four years. What is rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**** **

Rate of interest = {(1100 – 1000)/1000} = 10%

**Detailed Solution : **

Sum after three years = Rs. 1000

Sum after four years = Rs. 1100

For compound interest,

A = P (1 + r/100)t

⇒ 1000 = P(1 + r/100)³ ---- (1)

⇒ 1100 = P (1 + r/100)⁴ ---- (2)

From (2) /(1),

⇒ 11/10 = (1 + r/100)

⇒ 11/10 – 1= r/100

⇒ r/100 = 1/10

⇒ r = 100/10 = 10%

∴ Rate of interest is 10%.

There are 150 students in school. If the ratio of the number of boys to girls is 4 : 1, then what is the mean proportional between the number of boys and girls in the school?
questions.solution:
Number of boys = 4/5 × 150 = 120

⇒ Number of girls = 1/5 × 150 = 30

⇒ Mean proportional between the number of boys and girls = √( Number of boys × Number of girls)

⇒ Mean proportional between the number of boys and girls = √(120 × 30 = 60

∴ Mean proportional between the number of boys and girls is 60.

questions.question: A train crosses a 900 metres long platform in 300 seconds. If the length of train is 600 meters, then in how much time does it cross a stationary pole?
questions.solution:
Speed = distance/time

⇒ Speed of train = {(length of platform + length of train)/time taken by train to cross platform}

= (900 + 600)/300 = 5 m/sec.

⇒ Time = distance /speed = length of train / Speed of train = 600/5

⇒ Time = 120 seconds

⇒ Time = 120/60 = 2 minutes

∴ Train crosses a stationary pole in 2 minutes.

questions.question: Side of a square is first increased by 10% and then decreased by 20%. What is the overall percentage change in area?
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

Area of a square = a²

Where a be the length of the side of a square.

**Calculation:**

Let the side of the square be 100x.

Initial area of square = (100x)² **= **10000x²

Side of square after 10 % increase = 100x × (100 + 10)/100 = 110x

Side of square after 20 % decrease = 110x × (100 – 20)/100 = 88x

Final area of square = (88x)² **= **7744x²

Decrease in area = 10000x² – 7744x² = 2256x²

Percentage decrease = (2256x²/10000x²) × 100 = 22.56 %

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Change % = a + b + ab/100 [For increase take + sign and for decrease - sign]

⇒ Change % in length of side = 10 – 20 + [10 × (– 20)]/100

⇒ Change % in length of side = 10 – 20 – 2 = – 12%

Again,

⇒ Change % in area of square = – 12 – 12 + [(– 12) × (– 12)]/100

⇒ Change % in area of square = – 24 + 1.44 = – 22.56% (– denotes decrement)

**∴ The overall percentage change in area is decreased by 22.56%.**

questions.question: The diameter of a solid hemisphere is 35 cm. What is its total surface area? ( {Take pi = frac{{22}}{7}} )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the solid hemisphere = 35 cm.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Total Surface area of the hemisphere = C.S.A + Area of the base (Circle).

⇒ C.S.A of the hemisphere = 2πr².

⇒ Area of the base (Circle) = πr².

**Calculation:**

⇒ T.S.A of the hemisphere = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr².

**∴ T.S.A of the hemisphere = 3 × (22/7) × (35/2)² = 2887.5 cm². **

questions.question: The length of a cuboid is twice its breadth and its height is half of its breadth. If the height of the cuboid is 2 cm, then what is the edge of a cube having the same volume as that of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height = 2 cm

Height = breadth/2

Breadth = 4 cm

Length = 2 × Breadth = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

The volume of cuboid = Volume of cube

⇒ Length × Breadth × Height = (edge)³

**Calculation:**

⇒ (Edge)³ = 8 × 4 × 2 = 64

⇒ Edge = 4 cm

**∴ Edge of the cube is 4 cm.**

questions.question: The cost prices of articles A and B are Rs. 1200 and Rs. 1600 respectively. The selling price of article A is Rs. 1380 and the total profit on selling both the articles is 25%. What is the profit percentage on the selling of article B?
questions.solution:
The cost price of articles A and B = 1200 + 1600 = Rs. 2800

⇒ The selling price of articles A and B = cost price × (100 + profit)% = 2800 × 125%

⇒ The selling price of articles A and B = Rs. 3500

⇒ The selling price of articles A + the selling price of articles B = 3500

⇒ 1380 + the selling price of articles B = 3500

⇒ The selling price of articles B = Rs. 2120

⇒ Profit % on article B = [(2120 – 1600)/1600] × 100 = 520/16 = 32.5%

∴ The profit percentage on the selling of article B is 32.5%.

questions.question: What is the average maximum temperature of the city per day for the given ten days?
